summary: Frontend-only smoke test after LiveDesk.jsx syntax fix. App renders without webpack error overlay. All primary flows verified: hero desk photo, all 7 topic tabs, unlock-audio button triggers /api/audio/*.mp3 (200 audio/mpeg), lower-third shows only speaker name (no transcript body), ticker scrolls, /ask page shows 4 analyst cards with no unsplash images, /predictions page shows games with no ML/OU betting lines.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor spec mismatch: review request used hyphenated topic ids (e.g. topic-tab-league-wide) but implementation uses underscored ids (topic-tab-league_wide). Not a bug — but note the naming convention so future data-testid selectors are consistent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: LiveDesk.jsx is exactly 441 lines and compiles cleanly. All UI acceptance criteria pass. Topic tab data-testids use underscores (league_wide, trade_deadline, playoff_race, hot_takes, leafs, oilers, rangers). Audio unlock endpoint returns 200 audio/mpeg from /api/audio/{analyst}_{hash}.mp3.
rca of the issue: Original bug: orphaned duplicated JSX tail in LiveDesk.jsx caused webpack SyntaxError overlay to appear instead of the app. Main agent truncated file at line 441. Verified: file is now 441 lines, webpack compiled successfully, and runtime renders the full app UI with no error overlay.
